output_text:
name: "moai-lang-kotlin"
description: "Kotlin 2.0+ specialist for Ktor, coroutines, Compose Multiplatform, Android, server, and multiplatform development."
user-invocable: false
tags: ['kotlin', 'ktor', 'coroutines', 'compose', 'android', 'multiplatform']
context7-libraries: "/ktorio/ktor, /jetbrains/compose-multiplatform, /jetbrains/exposed"
related-skills: "moai-lang-java, moai-lang-swift"

Expertise: K2 compiler, coroutines/Flow, sealed/value classes, Ktor 3.0 (async HTTP, WebSocket, JWT), Exposed 0.55, Kotlin Spring WebFlux, Compose Desktop/iOS/Web/Android, JUnit 5, MockK, Kotest, Turbine. Auto-trigger on `.kt`, `.kts`, `build.gradle.kts`, `settings.gradle.kts`.

Coroutines: Use coroutineScope with async for parallel operations. Create deferred values with async, then call await on each to get results. Combine results into data classes. Create flow blocks with emit inside while loops; use delay for intervals and flowOn for dispatcher. Avoid runBlocking in suspend contexts. Use Dispatchers.IO for blocking operations.

Sealed/value classes: Define sealed interface with generic type parameter; data class success and data object Loading; use <REDACTED_USER> annotation with value class wrapping primitive; validate via init and require.

Ktor: Call embeddedServer with Netty, port, and host; configure Koin, security, routing, and content negotiation; call start with wait equals true. Install Koin and singleton single modules. Install Authentication and configure JWT realm, verifier, validate callback. Install ContentNegotiation with json. Define Application routing; route prefixes, post/call.receive unauthenticated endpoints, authenticate with verifier name, get/call.parameters, and call.respond status/body. Ensure ContentNegotiation is installed. Check JWT verifier configuration. Verify routing hierarchy.

Exposed: Define LongIdTable object with varchar, enumerationByName, timestamp, uniqueIndex(), defaultExpression. Use LongEntity and LongEntityClass, by properties, toModel. Repository takes Database; suspend methods wrap Exposed in dbQuery using newSuspendedTransaction with IO dispatcher; findById and Entity.new. Ensure all DB operations run within transaction context. Be aware of lazy entity loading outside transactions.

WebFlux: Annotate class with <REDACTED_USER> and <REDACTED_USER>; suspend endpoints with <REDACTED_USER> and <REDACTED_USER>; Flow collections via map; ResponseEntity status codes; <REDACTED_USER> validation.

Compose: Create <REDACTED_USER> function with ViewModel/callbacks; collectAsState; when sealed state renders Loading/Success/Error. List items use Card, Modifier.fillMaxWidth/clickable, Row/padding, AsyncImage/CircleShape clip, Column, MaterialTheme.typography.

Testing: mockk dependencies and initialize service in declaration; <REDACTED_USER> with runTest; coEvery/coAnswers with delay; assertThat; Flow toList and assert size/content.

Build: plugins kotlin("jvm"), kotlin("plugin.serialization") with version strings, and ktor.plugin. Configure kotlin jvmToolchain. Dependencies: Ktor server modules, kotlinx coroutines, Exposed, PostgreSQL; tests: mockk, coroutines-test, turbine.

K2: Add kotlin.experimental.tryK2=true to gradle.properties. Clear .gradle
